label: PF Backlog 227
title: Backend: AI-era operations layer (evals + prompt/model/agent versioning + feedback loop + model-quality observability)
body:
## Problem / why
Traditional SDLC (test -> deploy -> maintain) is not enough for AI products: non-deterministic outputs,
prompt/model versions, drift, and feedback need first-class support in verify (5-7) and operate (13).

## Goal & value
Add the AI-era lifecycle layer so the Product tab can show AI quality + the loop that keeps it good.

## In scope
- **Evals:** offline + online eval sets with thresholds; wire into verify stages and quality gate
  (reuse iterative_evaluator / quality_gate).
- **Versioning:** prompt/model/agent version registry; record which version produced an artifact; A/B.
- **Feedback loop:** user feedback + telemetry -> eval sets -> change requests (change_spec) -> releases.
- **Model-quality observability:** drift/hallucination/toxicity + cost/latency; OTel GenAI (BI-0199);
  reuse observer / post-production / product-analytics / finops.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Verify stages run evals with thresholds (pass/fail recorded); a regression blocks release.
- Every AI artifact records prompt+model versions; a feedback item can open a change request.
- Operate view exposes model-quality + cost/latency metrics.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: eval threshold gate; version stamping; feedback->change link.
- Integration: a model/prompt regression is caught before release.

## Links
BI-0199; post-production/observer/product-analytics; dashboard BI-0149.
